name: List of Bioluminescent Organisms (Glowies)
description: A Wikipedia hatnote on "List of bioluminescent organisms": "This article is about living organisms that are bioluminescent. For a list of organizations that 'glow in the dark', see United States Intelligence Community."
usage: Terry Davis's joke that CIA agents "glow in the dark", so you can see them coming. Reply to anything that looks like a fed, a honeypot or an op.
